close_reason: Fixed in 5e18f72: dropped _use_imports helper and the rights binding + "let _ = rights" workaround in address_book_round_trip_with_description; the test now asserts on the round-tripped value's description, removing the dead code.
description:
Two dead-code artifacts in crate-jmap-contacts-types/src/lib.rs test module:

1. lib.rs:669-672 — fn _use_imports() with body 'let _: HashMap<String, bool> = HashMap::new();'. The comment 'Suppress unused-import warnings' explains intent, but HashMap is now used by 18+ sloppy_field_* tests via 'let nicks: HashMap<String, Nickname> = ...' patterns. The workaround is now dead.

2. lib.rs:308-314, 333-334 — address_book_round_trip_with_description constructs a 'rights' AddressBookRights value, never uses it for any assertion, and silences the warning with 'let _ = rights'. The comment 'rights field unused directly; just suppress unused-variable warning' admits the dead code.

Workspace AGENTS.md 'No Dead Code': 'Never leave commented-out code, unused variables, TODO comments, or debug prints in committed code.' Test code is committed code.

Fix: delete fn _use_imports entirely; delete the rights construction and the 'let _ = rights' line from address_book_round_trip_with_description.
title: Dead test code: _use_imports helper and unused rights variable
